name.zh: 勇者之塔 第60层 洛比特、艾迪希洛、肯扎特

location.zh: 精灵太空站 资源区 勇者之塔

reward_note: Clearing 60F gave the new monster 肯 (4399 2009-12: 通过勇者之塔60层，就可以得到新精灵 肯), encoded as 肯 精元 per project policy; achievement 勇者之塔（五）+ title 勇者 from the client achievement table.

capture.zh: 勇者之塔第60层：洛比特、艾迪希洛、肯扎特（??级，多只连战）。通关60层获得新精灵肯。

strategy_notes.zh: 速度超过250的波克尔用同生共死。这三只精灵只受同系、普通和属性攻击伤害

engine_notes: Part of chain data/bosses/chains/tower_brave.json: floors are fought in order with no healing between floors; a lost battle sends the player back to floor 1 (restart_on_loss). Fleeing a floor did not reset progress (4399: 只剩一只精灵时除非胜券在握，最好逃跑).
Level shown as '??' (4399: 31~60层…等级都是能力高于100的??、???级，比玩家精灵高二十、三十级). Encoded as Lv120 for 31-50 and Lv130 for 51-60 (20-30 above the Lv100 cap).
HP is not published per floor. Two data points: 50F 水晶鸭 refills to 900; 57F 艾斯菲亚 has 750 HP. Estimates: 600 for 31-49, 750 for every 51-60 monster.
Multi-monster floor: the enemy fields its team one at a time (51-60层的怪都是两只以上一起上); win = KO all.

damage_only_from_own_type_normal_or_status: each of the three takes damage only from skills of its own type (洛比特 暗影 / 艾迪希洛 超能 / 肯扎特 战斗), from 普通系 skills, and from 属性 (status-category) skills such as 同生共死 (4399: 这三只精灵只受同系、普通和属性攻击伤害). This is damage_only_from with a per-member type list.
source_note: 4399 勇者之塔1-60层 (2010-04) and 51-60层精灵大揭秘 (2009-12-28): line-ups, 60F rule and 肯 reward.
